ORIGINAL PHENOMENON CONTEXT:
A rigid rotor is driven by a constant applied torque while rotational resistance grows with angular speed. Its angular velocity evolves from an independently chosen initial value, with the rotor inertia and drive conditions fixed in the baseline system. The target is angular acceleration and the expected long-time behavior is smooth relaxation toward a steady rotation rate.

CURRENT EQUATION:
  domega_dt = (drive_torque - resistance_coefficient * omega - nonlinear_drag_coefficient * (1 + thermal_drag_sensitivity * (resistance_coefficient - baseline_resistance_coefficient) / (thermal_drag_scale + Abs(resistance_coefficient - baseline_resistance_coefficient))) * omega**3 / (speed_transition + Abs(omega))) / rotor_inertia

CURRENT SYMBOLS (symbol [role] — description):

  t [V] — time
  omega [S] — Angular velocity about the fixed rotation axis
  resistance_coefficient [S] — Effective linear rotational resistance coefficient evolving through dissipation-driven thermal conditioning
  drive_torque [P] — Constant applied torque
  nonlinear_drag_coefficient [P] — Strength of the high-speed nonlinear rotational drag in the cold-reference condition
  speed_transition [P] — Speed scale setting the crossover from near-linear to stronger drag growth
  rotor_inertia [P] — Constant rotor inertia
  thermal_sensitivity [P] — Sensitivity of resistance growth to dissipated power
  cooling_time_constant [P] — Relaxation timescale for the resistance coefficient back toward its baseline value
  baseline_resistance_coefficient [P] — Cold baseline linear rotational resistance coefficient
  thermal_drag_sensitivity [P] — Strength of thermal enhancement of the nonlinear high-speed drag channel | suggested range: positive, typically small to order-one so heating measurably changes high-speed drag without reversing sign or dominating all losses
  thermal_drag_scale [P] — Thermal-conditioning scale over which nonlinear-drag enhancement saturates | suggested range: positive, comparable to the expected range of resistance_coefficient - baseline_resistance_coefficient during appreciable heating so the thermal modulation activates and then saturates

MODEL FAMILY: ode
EQUATION TYPE: ode_system

change only to auxiliary trajectories. Both can be scientifically valid, but

In shortcut_blocked, explain whether refitting ALL existing parent parameters

Before selecting the one refinement to return, screen possible refinements for:
(a) constant renaming or merging, e.g. k*x -> (k+a)*x with fixed k and a;
(b) algebraic cancellation, an identically zero contribution, or a branch that
cannot activate under the scenario's admissible conditions;
(c) a promoted quantity that remains constant in the intended experiment;
(d) a correction expected to be negligible throughout the admissible domain;
(e) only changing auxiliary trajectories while leaving the scored mapping from
supplied observations unchanged, e.g. making dv/dt complex when scoring dx/dt=v

these applies. Do not select a redundant change just to fill a generation slot.

response relationship, e.g. temperature-dependent stiffness with varying T;
parameter changes are not forbidden as a category.

and any weakness in derivation_notes. Implement the selected mechanism faithfully;
if the contract prevents activation, report it honestly rather than adding an
unrelated term. A completed generation is not evidence of increased difficulty.

selected this operation. Implement that plan; do not substitute an unrelated

- parameter_to_state: an EXISTING P symbol itself becomes S with its own RHS
